IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Haler, Ericks, Kretz, Dunn, Newhouse, McCune and O'Brien

Bill.BriefDescription: Creating a sales and use tax exemption for emergency services and law enforcement motor vehicles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for police and fireequipment; adding a new section to chapter 82.08 RCW; adding a newsection to chapter 82.12 RCW; and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales ofmotor vehicles to: (a) General authority Washington law enforcementagencies; or (b) local governments, if the vehicles are designed andconstructed specifically to provide emergency services, includingmedicalaid vehicles, ambulances, and fire engines. (2) A person taking the exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller shall retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) For the purposes of this section and section 2 of this act, thefollowing definitions apply: p. 1 HB 1620 (a) "General authority Washington law enforcement agency" has thesame meaning as in RCW 10.93.020, except "general authority Washingtonlaw enforcement agency" does not include the Washington state patrol orthe department of fish and wildlife. (b) "Local government" means any county, city, town, publichospital district, fire protection district, regional fire protectionservice authority, or emergency medical service district.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter may not apply with respect tothe use of motor vehicles by: (a) General authority Washington lawenforcement agencies; and (b) local governments if the vehicles areconstructed specifically to provide emergency services, includingmedicalaid vehicles, ambulances, and fire engines. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
